# roles

List roles for a user

## Usage

```
ppds users roles [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | yes | User ID (GUID) or domain name (e.g., user@domain.com) |

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |

| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--environment` | `-e` | `string` |  | Target environment (name, URL, or ID) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile to use |
